comment: Variation of dobuzz-rider-reintegrates-floating-eye: the hero is a gas spore, for which eyecount() is 2 and the part is the plural of the sphere's "optic nerve". A sleeping black dragon is created beside the hero, ^T moves the hero six squares east, a sleeping Death is created there and lands on the dragon's row, and a second ^T puts the hero on that row behind Death. The dragon wakes and breathes along the row; the blast reaches Death first. Seed and clock chosen freely.
